overall.summary: Every tool implements the effect its description states, and no described effect is missing. The undocumented behaviours are persistence and concurrency mechanics (lock file, temp-file atomic rename, permission preservation), graph-change notifications to subscribed clients, and small result-shape details such as erroring on missing entities in create_relations/add_observations and including endpoint-matching relations in search_nodes/open_nodes.

startup.behaviour: Reads the MEMORY_FILE_PATH environment variable, expands a leading '~' to the user's home directory, and resolves relative paths against the package directory; defaults to <package dir>/memory.jsonl
Renames a legacy memory.json to memory.jsonl when the new file does not exist, and aborts startup if the rename fails
Resolves the server version by reading package.json from the module directory or its parent
Registers a memory://knowledge-graph resource and a resources/subscribe capability so clients can subscribe to graph-change notifications
Writes 'Knowledge Graph MCP Server running on stdio' to stderr, sets process.exitCode = 1 on transport error, and exits with code 1 on fatal startup error
